title: BUG: "Bolus reported an error. Manually check real delivery insulin and carb amount" on APPSClient 3.3.3.0-dev-c
symptom: When using AAPSClient, the error message 'Bolus reported an error. Manually check real delivery insulin and carb amount' appears, but no bolus was actually delivered on AAPSFull and there were no microboluses at that time. The error message is repeating.
evidence_quote: When using AAPSClient, the following error message appears: "Bolus reported an error. Manually check real delivery insulin and carb amount" However, no bolus was actually delivered on AAPSFull, and there were no microboluses at that time either.
